method: Three sequential fresh processes per cohort; two visits per editor/Plan transition.
Focus 400 ms; ten keystrokes at 50 ms intervals; 200 ms settling.
CPU includes all app threads. Display callback metrics are not rendering hitches.
Fresh app processes do not imply cold keyboard. No completed post-reboot comparison.
The Schedule performance candidate included a Group-only Plan control, not mounted in the editor fixture. That control was subsequently reverted.
Prototype initialized-editors cohort extended focus; only its opening phases are included. Its Animation Hitches trace used corrected fixed timing.

baselineSchedule.note: Hitches are assigned by interval start. Rendering contexts and inclusive CPU stacks can overlap; do not add their durations or counts into wall-time percentages. Push intervals end at field readiness, not animation completion. Launch/seed work outside the signposts is excluded.
